name: oil-motion
title_zh: 让网页动起来的交互动画全流程技能
tagline_zh: 滚动、拖拽、陀螺仪、音频都能驱动动画。从设计到优化再到讲解，一个技能包圆，不用再翻十几个库的文档。
tagline_en: Scroll, drag, gyro, audio, state—all can drive motion. Design, build, optimize, explain in one flow. Stop.
desc_en: Design, implement, optimize, and explain interactive web animations driven by scroll, pointer, drag, touch, device orientation, audio, data, or component state. Use when a webpage needs responsive visual motion for products, interfaces, diagrams, characters, or scene transitions.
why_zh: 不是只写代码片段，而是把「设计意图→实现→性能调优→向他人解释」串成一条完整链路，且覆盖多种输入源。
why_en: It links design intent to implementation, performance tuning, and explanation—not just snippets. Handles many input sources in.
limit_zh: 只覆盖有明确输入源（滚动、指针、拖拽、触摸、陀螺仪、音频、数据、组件状态）驱动的动画。纯展示型、无交互的页面它不适用。
limit_en: Only for animations driven by explicit inputs (scroll/pointer/state/etc.). No visual design generation. Useless for static or purely decorative pages.
